In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement high-performance CUDA kernels for compute-intensive workloads across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Profile and optimize GPU code using tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and CUDA profilers.
  • Tune memory access patterns, occupancy, register usage, and shared memory utilization for peak performance.
  • Develop highly optimized libraries for linear algebra, attention, and other ML primitives.
  • Optimize multi-GPU and multi-node training using NCCL, RDMA, and high-performance networking.
  • Implement custom operators and fused kernels in PyTorch, JAX, or Triton.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to identify performance bottlenecks in training and inference pipelines.
  • Develop benchmarks and regression tests to safeguard performance over time.
  • Evaluate new GPU architectures and feature sets, and advise on adoption strategy.
  • Contribute to compiler-level optimizations for tensor programs where appropriate, working at the boundary between ML frameworks and underlying accelerator codegen to unlock performance not reachable through framework-level tuning alone.
  • Optimize memory hierarchy usage across HBM, L2, shared memory, and registers.
  • Implement mixed-precision and quantized compute paths that maximize accelerator throughput while preserving numerical fidelity within bounds acceptable for the target workloads.
  • Document performance characteristics, design decisions, and tuning playbooks for internal teams.
  • Stay current with GPU architecture, CUDA evolution, and emerging accelerator technologies.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.
  • Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.
  • Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.
  • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.
  • Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.
  • Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.
  • Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
  • Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.

PPC Specialist (Google Ads & Paid Media)

Google Ads | Local Services Ads (LSA) | Meta Ads | Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a PPC Specialist to own paid media strategy, execution, and optimization across multiple U.S. markets.

This is a hands-on, performance-focused role responsible for managing Google Ads, Local Services Ads (LSA), Meta Ads, and landing page optimization to generate qualified leads and maximize return on ad spend.

You’ll work with significant advertising budgets across multiple locations while continuously improving campaign performance through data analysis, testing, and optimization.

If you’re passionate about paid search, thrive in data-driven environments, and enjoy driving measurable business growth, this role is an excellent opportunity.

What You’ll Own

Google Ads & Local Services Ads (LSA)

  • Manage Google Ads MCC accounts across multiple locations.
  • Build, launch, and optimize Google Search campaigns.
  • Manage and improve Local Services Ads (LSA) performance.
  • Conduct keyword research, search term analysis, and negative keyword management.
  • Optimize bidding strategies, budgets, ad copy, and campaign structures.
  • Improve lead volume while reducing Cost Per Lead (CPL).
  • Monitor campaign pacing and budget allocation across markets.

Landing Page Optimization

  • Build and optimize landing pages using Unbounce or similar platforms.
  • Conduct A/B testing on headlines, forms, calls-to-action, layouts, and user experience.
  • Improve landing page conversion rates across locations and service lines.
  • Create new location-specific and service-specific landing pages.
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to improve conversion performance.

Meta Ads (Preferred)

  • Manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
  • Develop audience targeting strategies for lead generation and brand awareness.
  • Test creative assets, messaging, and campaign structures.
  • Optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and advertising efficiency.

Performance Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare weekly and monthly paid media performance reports.
  • Monitor key metrics including:
    • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
    • Cost Per Booked Job
    • Conversion Rate
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Identify performance trends and optimization opportunities.
  • Present actionable recommendations to improve campaign performance.
  • Monitor advertising budgets and maximize return on investment.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on PPC management experience.
  • Strong experience managing Google Ads Search campaigns.
  • Experience managing Local Services Ads (LSA).
  • Experience managing multi-location or franchise-style advertising accounts.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads MCC account structures.
  • Experience optimizing landing pages using Unbounce, Instapage, or similar platforms.
  • Experience managing significant monthly advertising budgets.

Technical Skills

  • Google Ads
  • Google Ads MCC
  • Local Services Ads (LSA)
  • Google Analytics
  • Keyword research and bid optimization
  • Conversion tracking
  • Performance reporting
  • Landing page optimization
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience within home services, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, restoration, or similar industries.
  • Experience managing Google Business Profile (GBP).
  • Familiarity with CallRail, CallTrackingMetrics, or similar call tracking platforms.
  • Experience with pay-per-lead advertising platforms.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge.
  • Experience using AI tools and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly analytical and data-driven.
  • Strong ownership mentality with excellent follow-through.
  • Comfortable managing multiple campaigns across different markets.
  • Proactive problem solver who identifies opportunities independently.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Continuously learning and adapting to platform updates and best practices.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review Google Ads and LSA campaign performance.
  • Optimize keywords, bids, audiences, and campaign structures.
  • Analyze search terms and update negative keyword lists.
  • Improve landing page conversion rates through testing.
  • Monitor budgets and campaign pacing.
  • Review lead quality and performance metrics.
  • Build reports and share optimization recommendations with leadership.
  • Test new campaign strategies and creative approaches.

In short: You are responsible for maximizing lead generation and return on ad spend by managing, optimizing, and scaling paid media campaigns across multiple markets.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Increased qualified lead volume.
  • Reduced Cost Per Lead (CPL).
  • Reduced Cost Per Booked Job.
  • Improved Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Landing page conversion rate improvements.
  • Budget pacing and allocation accuracy.
  • Continuous campaign optimization and testing.
  • Overall marketing performance across multiple markets.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote opportunity aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Manage large-scale, multi-location advertising campaigns.
  • Direct impact on business growth and lead generation.
  • Work with modern marketing tools and platforms.
  • High ownership with opportunities to influence marketing strategy.
  • Career growth into Senior PPC Specialist, Paid Media Manager, or Digital Marketing Lead roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Google Ads & Campaign Optimization Scenario)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced PPC Specialist with a proven track record of managing Google Ads, Local Services Ads, and high-performing paid media campaigns, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive measurable growth through data-driven digital advertising.

Working as part of a collaborative team that includes managing directors, relationship managers, and executive services associates, the Executive Planning Consultant drives client engagement, business growth, and client satisfaction. raw.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

About the Role

Arrowhead Intermediaries is looking for a Data Quality Analyst to join our Data Strategy and Business Intelligence organization. This role sits at the intersection of statistical rigor and data governance: you'll own the quality, integrity, and reliability of the data that powers our reporting, analytics, and downstream machine learning applications. You'll work closely with the Director of Data Products to define what “good data” means for our systems, then build the validation logic, controls, and investigative processes to enforce it.

This is a great fit for someone who thinks like an analyst but cares as much about why the numbers are wrong as what the numbers say, someone comfortable owning a data quality question end to end: framing it, tracing it to root cause, and communicating the fix to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Difficult data quality problems rarely have an off-the-shelf fix. We need someone who can reason from first principles: questioning assumptions about how the data was generated, tracing a discrepancy back to its source system, and building a systematic validation approach.

What You'll Do

  • Design and maintain validation rules, reconciliation processes, and quality checks across systems of record
  • Investigate data integrity issues, tracing discrepancies between platforms and systems back to root cause
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and profiling workflows in Python/R and SQL to support cleaning, structuring, and validation of incoming data
  • Partner with data engineering and BI teams to define review and approval controls for data entering reporting and analytics pipelines
  • Apply statistical methods (descriptive and inferential) to detect anomalies, quantify data quality issues, and support root cause analysis
  • Evaluate the behavior and output of machine learning or scoring models against real-world outcomes, flagging drift or inconsistency
  • Translate data quality findings into clear, actionable reporting for non-technical decision-makers and leadership
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define data quality metrics, standards, and reporting cadences across the Data Strategy and Business Intelligence organization

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with Python/R and SQL for data profiling, cleaning, and validation
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis: hypothesis framing, exploratory data analysis, interpretation of uncertainty
  • Exposure to machine learning concepts and an understanding of how model output is evaluated for quality and consistency
  • Demonstrated experience designing data validation rules, reconciliation processes, or quality controls across multiple systems of record
  • Strong root-cause investigation skills, comfortable tracing data discrepancy from symptom to source
  • A systems mindset: able to see how data flows across upstream sources, pipelines, and downstream consumers, and to spot where a fix in one place will surface problems in another
  • A first-principles approach to problem-solving: able to break an unfamiliar or ambiguous data quality issue down to its underlying causes rather than relying on standard playbooks
  • Comfortable working closely with engineering teams, whether that means partnering on pipeline changes, scoping a fix at its source, or translating a data quality issue into something an engineer can act on
  • Visualization and communication skills (Matplotlib, ggplot, and/or Power BI) to make findings accessible to non-technical audiences
  • Experience with AI tooling and LLM-based workflows (e.g., Claude, GPT) is important

A background in data science, analytics, or a related field, formal training or eq

Pay Range

$80,000.00 - $95,000.00 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead Information for Planning and Consultation (IPaC) website application architecture updates and API integration for a federal data migration program. You will design and implement the integration between the federal consultation platform and the cloud data infrastructure, enabling new species data to flow seamlessly into existing consultation workflows.

Work Location: Remote

Day To Day Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead application architecture updates to support new species data integration, ensuring all changes comply with platform constraints and IT governance standards
  • Design and implement API integration between the application and the cloud data platform, enabling species data retrieval for consultation workflows
  • Implement new species display functionality within the platform, including habitat designations, listing status, and regulatory requirements
  • Develop programmatic consultation logic alignment updates, implementing joint agency consultation handling logic
  • Support the establishment and maintenance of the demo environment for government demonstrations
  • Support interoperability testing by resolving application-layer defects identified during testing
  • Contribute to the IPaC UI and Logic Update Package, delivering all application-layer integration components including API connections, species display functionality, and joint agency consultation handling logic for government review
  • Support delivery of Updated DKeys and Consultation Package Builder Assets by implementing platform-side integration updates required to support new DKey content and consultation package assembly workflows
  • Execute production cutover application deployment activities per the approved migration playbook
  • Contribute to the Final Operational Playbooks by documenting application maintenance procedures and incident response protocols

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree and 8 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 6 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 10 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 12 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • Extensive experience with software development with a focus on federal application integration
  • Experience designing and implementing REST API integrations between federal applications and cloud data platforms
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, or equivalent backend development languages
  • Experience with Git or equivalent version control platforms for federal application code management and deployment
  • Experience with federal software development standards and FedRAMP-compliant deployment
  • Familiarity with Section 508/WCAG 2.0 accessibility requirements for federal application development
  • Familiarity with federal IT governance frameworks and platform constraint management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Information for Planning and Consultation (IPaC) platform or similar federal environmental decision support systems
  • Familiarity with DKey systems or consultation package builder platforms within federal environmental decision support tools
  • Familiarity with Databricks or cloud data lakehouse API integration
  • Familiarity with integration testing frameworks or API contract testing tools (Postman, SoapUI, or equivalent)
  • Experience with Agile/iterative software development on federal programs
  • Experience with DOI, FWS, or NOAA Fisheries IT environments

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. About the opportunity

VictoriaMetrics is a fast-growing company revolutionizing open-source monitoring and observability solutions. We’re trusted by enterprises and the open-source community alike to provide high-performance, scalable solutions. We operate in a dynamic, startup environment where innovation and customer satisfaction are at the core of what we do.

As our Support Department evolves, we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated VictoriaMetrics Expert to join our Expertise Center team. This role is for an experienced specialist with a strong background in development and/or high-level systems engineering. We need a specialist with a proven track record of deep technical analysis who will focus on building our internal technical expertise to provide first-class assistance to our enterprise clients, develop internal monitoring, and create tooling.

Role Overview:

Your responsibilities as a VictoriaMetrics Expert will include:

  • Taking deep dives into complex customer issues, reproducing them in sandbox environments, including under load.

  • Work closely with the development team to resolve identified problems.

  • Creating and developing internal tooling (Go is a significant advantage) to improve observability, automation (e.g., problem detection, AI integrations), and overall operational efficiency.

  • Developing internal monitoring, creating runbooks, dashboards, and guides.

  • Handling problem management: performing root cause analysis and driving long-term solutions, including creating artifacts (docs, runbooks).

  • Building and maintaining the internal knowledge base to support other teams.

  • Collaborating with other teams (engineering, customer success, solution engineering) to address complex issues and contribute to product improvement.

  • Participating in critical incident resolution with a focus on rapid mitigation followed by root cause analysis.

  • The preferred time zone for this position is GMT -5 – GMT -8.

  • We operate in a fully remote setup with a flexible schedule. This is a contract position (a service agreement with a US entity; self-employed or sole proprietor status is possible).

Key Qualifications:

  • Required Experience:

    • A minimum of 4-5+ years in a senior technical position, such as Software Developer, SRE, Performance Engineer, or Systems Engineer role.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Advanced troubleshooting skills.

    • Deep knowledge of programming or scripting languages (experience with Go is a plus).

    • Practical experience with Kubernetes (K8s).

    • Knowledge of Linux (advanced knowledge is a plus).

    • Understanding of IT infrastructure and troubleshooting distributed systems.

  • Soft Skills:

    • Excellent communication skills, able to clearly explain complex technical concepts in English.

    • A passion for solving complex technical problems and building expertise.

    • A sense of responsibility and urgency working with external customers.

    • A quick learner with a proactive attitude and a passion for problem-solving.

  • Startup Mindset:

    • Comfortable with evolving processes and the need for flexibility.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with VictoriaMetrics or other time-series databases/monitoring tools (Grafana/Prometheus).

  • Familiarity with VictoriaLogs or other log storage and analysis platforms is a strong plus

  • Experience with open-source technologies and community engagement.

About VictoriaMetrics:

We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution: VictoriaMetrics. We’ve recently introduced our open source logs management product, VictoriaLogs, as well as the brand-new VictoriaTraces. Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core monitoring & observability solutions. Our services are used by Spotify, Hubspot, WIX, Grammarly, CERN and thousands of others. Our open source products have been downloaded 1B+ times to date. We are a profitable company with a fully remote team distributed worldwide.

Interview Process:

  • Introductory Video Call (30 min): Meet to discuss your experience and fit and clarify role and expectations.

  • Technical Interview (1 hr): A deep dive into your technical skills with our team.

  • Call with founders (optional, 30 min): An extra session, if needed.

  • Offer: Embark on your journey with VictoriaMetrics.

Title: Application Support Analyst

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Application Support Analyst is responsible for delivering technical support and troubleshooting for Duck Creek Technologies' software applications. This role focuses on managing daily support requests, monitoring system performance, and assisting with issue resolution. The analyst will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the efficient operation of the company's software applications.

  • Provide first-line technical support for Duck Creek applications, responding to user inquiries and resolving incidents.

  • Monitor application performance and system health to ensure optimal uptime and performance.

  • Investigate and troubleshoot application issues, working to identify root causes and implement resolutions.

  • Escalate complex issues to senior team members or specialized departments when necessary.

  • Assist in the deployment of application updates, patches, and system enhancements.

  • Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions for future reference in support knowledge bases.

  • Work with internal teams to identify recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions to improve system performance.

  • Perform routine maintenance tasks such as monitoring logs, conducting system checks, and applying patches.

  • Utilize monitoring tools to track system performance metrics and identify potential risks or performance bottlenecks.

  • Collaborate with application development and infrastructure teams to resolve issues and implement new features.

  • Ensure adherence to established service level agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution times.

  • Participate in training sessions and stay up to date on system updates, application changes, and new functionalities.

WHAT YOU’VE DONE:

REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 1-2 years of experience in application support, IT operations, or a similar technical support role.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience with Duck Creek Technologies products or similar enterprise software.

  • Knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL.

  • Experience in the insurance technology sector or related industries.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Behaviors: Bulleted list of descriptors and technical skills describing the REQUIRED KSABs, not listed in competencies above,to perform the role.

  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to resolve basic application issues.

  • Knowledge of application monitoring tools and system health metrics.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively document incidents and collaborate with team members.

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Understanding of IT environments, including basic networking, infrastructure, and cloud technologies.

  • Ability to escalate complex issues and collaborate with senior staff to resolve them.

  • Familiarity with enterprise software release cycles and deployment processes.

  • Knowledge of incident, problem, and change management processes.

  • Customer-oriented mindset, focused on providing prompt and effective technical support.

  • Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail in managing incident logs and troubleshooting steps.

  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies and stay updated on new features and system enhancements.

  • Basic knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies as they relate to application support.

raw.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer II who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for solving our most challenging problems along with a highly-motivated team. In this role, you will work closely with other engineers across multiple teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative products.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include partnering with other engineers to design, develop, and deliver new features. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

Key Role Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain new innovative product features focused on actively learning new areas of the product
  • Collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements
  • Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform
  • Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews
  • Mentor other engineers who are starting along their career path
  • Work with the team to continuously build and deploy scalable solutions
  • Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders

Minimum Requirements:

  • Experience solving technical problems as part of a team
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, with React experience preferred
  • Ability to solve problems with backend-focused languages like Go or similar compiled statically typed language
  • Intermediate understanding of relational databases like MySQL

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)
  • Familiar with the basic principles and design of RESTful APIs
  • Basic knowledge of a Microservice Architecture
  • Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

Job Summary

Your Career

We are looking for a results-oriented, high-energy marketing professional to join our LATAM Field Marketing organization. You will play a pivotal role in transforming our regional presence by executing innovative demand generation programs tailored to Chile. You will partner closely with local solutions leadership and our partner ecosystem to accelerate the adoption of our platform-centric solutions. If you are a collaborative marketer who excels at blending data-driven decision-making with creative, "on-the-ground" execution, this is the opportunity to shape the next chapter of growth for Palo Alto Networks in Latin America.

Your Impact

  • Solutions Delivery: Lead the local execution of LATAM priority campaigns.

  • Solutions Alignment: Serve as a key marketing partner to the local solutions team. Actively participate in solutions meetings, QBRs, and regional campaign meetings to ensure marketing activities are directly influencing the pipeline.

  • Transactional Growth: Execute micro-campaigns by solution to address pipeline gaps, focusing on downmarket strategies.

  • Partner Co-Marketing: Implement and manage solution campaigns scaling our reach through local distributors, service providers, and partners.

  • Execution Excellence: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of programs, from target selection and digital execution to post-campaign analysis and ROI reporting.

  • Platform Advocacy: Drive the narrative of our platform evolution - shifting the conversation from "point products" to our integrated security platform - ensuring consistency in messaging across every local touchpoint.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of B2B marketing experience in the technology/SaaS sector. Deep understanding of demand generation metrics, funnel management, and campaign execution.

  • Strategic Execution: Proven track record of managing multi-channel programs, including events, digital media, and partner-led initiatives.

  • Business Acumen: Ability to translate high-level growth targets into actionable marketing plans. Strong understanding of the Latin American business landscape and sub-regional market nuances (Chile).

  • Collaboration: A natural collaborator who can build strong, trusted relationships with cross-functional teams, including Sales, BDRs, Partner Marketing, and Global Marketing teams.

  • Data-Driven: Proficiency in marketing automation (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua) and CRM (Salesforce) to track performance, optimize ROI, and report on KPI achievement.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.

  • Language: Fluency in Spanish (mandatory) and professional proficiency in English (essential for HQ alignment).

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

raw.description:
The DIRECTV IT team builds experiences that efficiently offer our products to prospects, delight our customers, and create a connected omnichannel experience. Within this, the Existing Customer Lifecycle value stream builds experiences that enable customers to get the most from their DIRECTV service and empowers our front-line team members who help them with intelligent technology. Our scope includes customer-facing self-service capabilities on DIRECTV.com, our IVR (interactive voice response), and applications for our field technicians and customer care phone agents.

We are seeking an expert and highly motivated IT Software Engineer Principal 2 to join our technology team. This pivotal role is responsible for driving the technical design, implementation, and reliability of our next-generation Customer Experience (CX) orchestration platforms, centered on AWS, Genesys Cloud, and Salesforce Service Cloud. The successful candidate will be a deep technical expert, leading the adoption of cloud-native development practices (AWS), advanced automation (Terraform, CI/CD), conversational AI, advanced routing (Genesys Cloud), and critical integrations with platforms like Salesforce Service Cloud. You will act as a senior technical leader, guiding global, cross-functional teams in an agile environment to ensure our mission-critical CX systems are scalable, secure, and highly performant.

Here's what you'll do:

  • Guide development and modernization of critical customer and agent facing applications.
  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designing, deploying, and managing core CX applications and infrastructure leveraging cloud services (AWS, Azure etc.) for contact center domain.
  • Lead development of data pathways between internal and external systems, especially with integration to CRM, AI Platforms, and APIs.
  • Govern all aspects of the application design including providing input on application architecture, modern technologies and development techniques, and patterns to create sustainable technology.
  • Ensure security and compliance for the data and services stored and passed by these systems.
  • Lead the development of new technologies based on best practices and a coaching mindset for more junior team members.
  • Govern vendor teams to develop to our desired technical vision, minimizing technical debt and ensuring productive, predictable output from our partners.
  • Serve as the domain technical expert, representing system capabilities to business and technology teams alike, understanding desired business outcomes, and guiding the solution to the most effective implementation; be comfortable communicating progress, roadblocks, and opportunities to all levels in the organization.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams to define and hone technical best-practices; evangelize these and support change across teams where needed.
  • Participate in defining and developing DevOPS best practices, including Production Support and deployment process, and additionally help troubleshoot critical production issues.
  • A strong communicator, able to effectively synthesize key points of a topic and turn them into a persuasive conversation, presentation, or email.

Here's what you'll need to be successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5 – 7 years required, 8+ years desired of progressive experience in software development and architecture, with at least 4 years focused on high-scale Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), CX enterprise software or Field Services enterprise software.
  • Expert-level, hands-on experience with Salesforce Platforms, APIs and custom solutions development. Experience with Agent force and prompt engineering.
  • Deep expertise in AWS services (e.g., Lambda, EC2, SQS, Kinesis) and proven production experience using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Demonstrated success designing and maintaining sophisticated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) for cloud-native or CCaaS application deployments.
  • Extensive experience designing and building reliable integrations with major CRMs, specifically Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Experience working with REST and SOAP based web-services preferred.
  • Experience with Postman, SOAPUI, Mockito preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate as a senior technical lead, driving technical consensus and solution delivery across global teams leveraging agile frameworks such as SAFe.
  • Strong understanding of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., PCI, SOC 2), and performance optimization within a cloud-based CX platform.
  • Exceptional communication and documentation skills for translating complex technical decisions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certification (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional).
  • Certification or advanced training specific to Genesys Cloud development/administration.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with advanced predictive modeling or machine learning applications in a real-time routing context.

May require a background check due to job duties requiring routine access to DIRECTV and DIRECTV customer’s proprietary data. Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction will be considered for employment in accordance with local ordinances and state law.

About the opportunity

VictoriaMetrics is a fast-growing company revolutionizing open-source monitoring and observability solutions. We’re trusted by enterprises and the open-source community alike to provide high-performance, scalable solutions. We operate in a dynamic, startup environment where innovation and customer satisfaction are at the core of what we do.

As our Support Department evolves, we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated VictoriaMetrics Expert to join our Expertise Center team. This role is for an experienced specialist with a strong background in development and/or high-level systems engineering. We need a specialist with a proven track record of deep technical analysis who will focus on building our internal technical expertise to provide first-class assistance to our enterprise clients, develop internal monitoring, and create tooling.

Role Overview:

Your responsibilities as a VictoriaMetrics Expert will include:

  • Taking deep dives into complex customer issues, reproducing them in sandbox environments, including under load.

  • Work closely with the development team to resolve identified problems.

  • Creating and developing internal tooling (Go is a significant advantage) to improve observability, automation (e.g., problem detection, AI integrations), and overall operational efficiency.

  • Developing internal monitoring, creating runbooks, dashboards, and guides.

  • Handling problem management: performing root cause analysis and driving long-term solutions, including creating artifacts (docs, runbooks).

  • Building and maintaining the internal knowledge base to support other teams.

  • Collaborating with other teams (engineering, customer success, solution engineering) to address complex issues and contribute to product improvement.

  • Participating in critical incident resolution with a focus on rapid mitigation followed by root cause analysis.

  • The preferred time zone for this position is GMT -5 – GMT -8.

  • We operate in a fully remote setup with a flexible schedule. This is a contract position (a service agreement with a US entity; self-employed or sole proprietor status is possible).

Key Qualifications:

  • Required Experience:

    • A minimum of 4-5+ years in a senior technical position, such as Software Developer, SRE, Performance Engineer, or Systems Engineer role.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Advanced troubleshooting skills.

    • Deep knowledge of programming or scripting languages (experience with Go is a plus).

    • Practical experience with Kubernetes (K8s).

    • Knowledge of Linux (advanced knowledge is a plus).

    • Understanding of IT infrastructure and troubleshooting distributed systems.

  • Soft Skills:

    • Excellent communication skills, able to clearly explain complex technical concepts in English.

    • A passion for solving complex technical problems and building expertise.

    • A sense of responsibility and urgency working with external customers.

    • A quick learner with a proactive attitude and a passion for problem-solving.

  • Startup Mindset:

    • Comfortable with evolving processes and the need for flexibility.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with VictoriaMetrics or other time-series databases/monitoring tools (Grafana/Prometheus).

  • Familiarity with VictoriaLogs or other log storage and analysis platforms is a strong plus

  • Experience with open-source technologies and community engagement.

About VictoriaMetrics:

We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution: VictoriaMetrics. We’ve recently introduced our open source logs management product, VictoriaLogs, as well as the brand-new VictoriaTraces. Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core monitoring & observability solutions. Our services are used by Spotify, Hubspot, WIX, Grammarly, CERN and thousands of others. Our open source products have been downloaded 1B+ times to date. We are a profitable company with a fully remote team distributed worldwide.

Interview Process:

  • Introductory Video Call (30 min): Meet to discuss your experience and fit and clarify role and expectations.

  • Technical Interview (1 hr): A deep dive into your technical skills with our team.

  • Call with founders (optional, 30 min): An extra session, if needed.

  • Offer: Embark on your journey with VictoriaMetrics.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer II who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for solving our most challenging problems along with a highly-motivated team. In this role, you will work closely with other engineers across multiple teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative products.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include partnering with other engineers to design, develop, and deliver new features. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

Key Role Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain new innovative product features focused on actively learning new areas of the product
  • Collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements
  • Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform
  • Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews
  • Mentor other engineers who are starting along their career path
  • Work with the team to continuously build and deploy scalable solutions
  • Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders

Minimum Requirements:

  • Experience solving technical problems as part of a team
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, with React experience preferred
  • Ability to solve problems with backend-focused languages like Go or similar compiled statically typed language
  • Intermediate understanding of relational databases like MySQL

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)
  • Familiar with the basic principles and design of RESTful APIs
  • Basic knowledge of a Microservice Architecture
  • Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.description:
The DIRECTV IT team builds experiences that efficiently offer our products to prospects, delight our customers, and create a connected omnichannel experience. Within this, the Existing Customer Lifecycle value stream builds experiences that enable customers to get the most from their DIRECTV service and empowers our front-line team members who help them with intelligent technology. Our scope includes customer-facing self-service capabilities on DIRECTV.com, our IVR (interactive voice response), and applications for our field technicians and customer care phone agents.

We are seeking an expert and highly motivated IT Software Engineer Principal 2 to join our technology team. This pivotal role is responsible for driving the technical design, implementation, and reliability of our next-generation Customer Experience (CX) orchestration platforms, centered on AWS, Genesys Cloud, and Salesforce Service Cloud. The successful candidate will be a deep technical expert, leading the adoption of cloud-native development practices (AWS), advanced automation (Terraform, CI/CD), conversational AI, advanced routing (Genesys Cloud), and critical integrations with platforms like Salesforce Service Cloud. You will act as a senior technical leader, guiding global, cross-functional teams in an agile environment to ensure our mission-critical CX systems are scalable, secure, and highly performant.

Here's what you'll do:

  • Guide development and modernization of critical customer and agent facing applications.
  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designing, deploying, and managing core CX applications and infrastructure leveraging cloud services (AWS, Azure etc.) for contact center domain.
  • Lead development of data pathways between internal and external systems, especially with integration to CRM, AI Platforms, and APIs.
  • Govern all aspects of the application design including providing input on application architecture, modern technologies and development techniques, and patterns to create sustainable technology.
  • Ensure security and compliance for the data and services stored and passed by these systems.
  • Lead the development of new technologies based on best practices and a coaching mindset for more junior team members.
  • Govern vendor teams to develop to our desired technical vision, minimizing technical debt and ensuring productive, predictable output from our partners.
  • Serve as the domain technical expert, representing system capabilities to business and technology teams alike, understanding desired business outcomes, and guiding the solution to the most effective implementation; be comfortable communicating progress, roadblocks, and opportunities to all levels in the organization.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams to define and hone technical best-practices; evangelize these and support change across teams where needed.
  • Participate in defining and developing DevOPS best practices, including Production Support and deployment process, and additionally help troubleshoot critical production issues.
  • A strong communicator, able to effectively synthesize key points of a topic and turn them into a persuasive conversation, presentation, or email.

Here's what you'll need to be successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5 – 7 years required, 8+ years desired of progressive experience in software development and architecture, with at least 4 years focused on high-scale Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), CX enterprise software or Field Services enterprise software.
  • Expert-level, hands-on experience with Salesforce Platforms, APIs and custom solutions development. Experience with Agent force and prompt engineering.
  • Deep expertise in AWS services (e.g., Lambda, EC2, SQS, Kinesis) and proven production experience using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Demonstrated success designing and maintaining sophisticated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) for cloud-native or CCaaS application deployments.
  • Extensive experience designing and building reliable integrations with major CRMs, specifically Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Experience working with REST and SOAP based web-services preferred.
  • Experience with Postman, SOAPUI, Mockito preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate as a senior technical lead, driving technical consensus and solution delivery across global teams leveraging agile frameworks such as SAFe.
  • Strong understanding of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., PCI, SOC 2), and performance optimization within a cloud-based CX platform.
  • Exceptional communication and documentation skills for translating complex technical decisions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certification (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional).
  • Certification or advanced training specific to Genesys Cloud development/administration.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with advanced predictive modeling or machine learning applications in a real-time routing context.

We are looking for a Senior Director, Cyber Security to join our Information Security team. This is an exciting opportunity to lead enterprise-wide cyber security strategy, strengthen security operations, and help protect Clarivate’s systems, products, data, and customers, including technology and data supporting healthcare, life sciences, and other regulated environments. In this role, you will partner closely with Technology, Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Quality, and business leaders to advance a risk-based security program, improve control maturity, and support the continued resilience of Clarivate’s Life Science business.

About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 12+ years of experience in cyber securitywithin healthcare, life sciences, or other highly regulated environments.

  • 5+ years of experience leading cyber security teams, programs, or cross-functional security initiatives.

  • Familiarity with relevant healthcare and life sciences requirements and standards, includingGxP, FDA regulations, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, computerized system validation, and data integrity principles.

  • Experience defining and executing enterprise cyber security strategy, roadmaps, controls, and operating models.

  • Experience overseeing security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, threat monitoring, security engineering, or cyber risk management.

  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, CIS Controls, or similar standards.

  • Experience translating cyber risk, security metrics, and technical concepts into clear recommendations for senior leadership and business stakeholders.

It would be great if you also have . . .

  • Relevant security certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in a global, matrixed organization with complex technology environments and regulated customer requirements.

  • Experience with cloud security across AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid cloud environments.

  • Experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, IAM, DLP, vulnerability management, third-party risk, or other enterprise security technologies.

  • Experience supporting secure software development, product security, customer security assurance, or security-by-design programs.

  • Experience leading incident readiness, tabletop exercises, penetration testing, red team/blue team activities, or post-incident improvement programs.

What will you be doing in this role?

  • Support customer assurance, audits, and regulatory inspections involving healthcare, life sciences,GxP, or other regulated products and technology environments.

  • Define and execute the cyber security strategy, roadmap, and operating model to reduce enterprise risk and strengthen Clarivate’s security posture.

  • Lead cyber security programs across security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, security engineering, governance, risk, and compliance.

  • Partner with Technology, Product, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and business leaders to embed security requirements into products, platforms, processes, and vendor relationships.

  • Oversee monitoring, escalation, investigation, and response processes for security incidents, including coordination with internal teams and external partners as needed.

  • Drive improvement of security controls, policies, standards, procedures, dashboards, metrics, and reporting aligned to internal requirements and external frameworks.

  • Evaluate current and emerging cyber threats,identifysecurity gaps, and prioritize remediation activities in partnership with technology and product teams.

  • Support audit, certification, customer assurance, and regulatory activities by ensuring security practices are documented, measurable, and continuously improved.

  • Develop and lead a high-performing cyber security team, including resource planning, capability development, coaching, and prioritization of work against business-criticalobjectives.

  • Communicate cyber risk, program performance, incident trends, and strategic recommendations to executive and senior leadership audiences.

About the Team

The Information Security teamis responsible forhelping safeguard Clarivate’s information assets and supporting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our systems, products, and data. The team partners across Technology, Product, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, and business functions to manage cyber risk, support security operations, advancegovernanceand compliance programs, and continuously improve Clarivate’s global security posture.

Hours of Work

This is a full-time position, primarily working core business hours in your time zone, with flexibility topartner acrossglobal time zones as needed.This role may require availability outside of standard business hours to support urgent security incidents, escalations, or business-critical events.

raw.description:
About the Job

We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Installation Service to independently execute and oversee complex server and network deployments supporting enterprise physical security systems. In this mid-level role, you will take ownership of installation projects, configure advanced infrastructure components, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure seamless integration between servers, network equipment, and security endpoints. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including physical security installers and sustaining operations, while mentoring junior engineers. This position demands strong technical expertise in Dell server platforms and Cisco networking, along with the ability to provide 24x7 support in a globally distributed environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead hardware provisioning activities including advanced RAID configuration and disk array optimization to meet performance and redundancy requirements for high-write-volume security applications such as video storage systems.

  • Configure and validate Integrated Dell Remote Access Controller (iDRAC) and Lifecycle Controller settings, ensuring firmware baselines are established using Dell OpenManage before OS deployment.

  • Independently deploy operating systems via PXE boot automation or iDRAC Virtual Media methods, including Windows Server and hardened Linux distributions, ensuring compliance with corporate standards.

  • Design and implement network segmentation strategies using VLANs and dedicated subnets to isolate physical security traffic (CCTV, PIDS, Intercom) from management networks.

  • Configure Quality of Service (QoS) policies on Cisco Catalyst switches to prioritize high-bandwidth video streams, ensuring low latency and minimal packet loss for live monitoring and retention systems.

  • Manage Power over Ethernet (PoE/PoE+) budgeting and monitoring on access layer switches, ensuring reliable power delivery to IP cameras, door readers, and security panels.

  • Implement network device hardening best practices on Cisco IOS devices, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), disabling unnecessary services, and securing management protocols (SSH/HTTPS).

  • Coordinate with Network Engineers and Physical Security Installation Teams to validate network readiness, port activations, and successful device-to-server communication paths.

  • Execute comprehensive validation testing including bandwidth saturation tests, physical layer distance checks, and latency measurements before operational handoff to sustainment teams.

  • Develop detailed "As-Built" documentation including logical and physical topology diagrams, VLAN matrices, IP assignment records, and configuration backups.

  • Provide 24x7 technical support for all in-scope infrastructure systems, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions for medium-complexity issues.

  • Deliver weekly project status updates and maintain programming sheet validations, as-built documentation, and asset management system accuracy throughout deployment lifecycle.

Required Skills

  • Related field experience with 6+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise server and network infrastructure deployment.

  • Strong expertise in Dell PowerEdge server platforms including RAID controllers (PERC), iDRAC configuration, firmware management, and Lifecycle Controller operations.

  • Proficient in Cisco networking technologies including Catalyst switches, VLAN configuration, QoS implementation, PoE management, and IOS security hardening.

  • Solid experience with Windows Server and Linux operating system deployment, administration, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments.

  • Working knowledge of scripting languages (Python, PowerShell) and automation tools for configuration management and deployment acceleration.

  • Excellent communication skills with ability to collaborate across technical teams and provide mentorship to junior engineers while working in 24x7 rotational support models.

Tools Required

  • Server & Hardware Tools: Dell iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, OpenManage, RAID/PERC utilities for server provisioning, firmware baselining, and remote management.

  • OS Deployment Tools: PXE boot infrastructure, iDRAC Virtual Media, Windows Server & Linux ISOs with hardening and automation scripts.

  • Network Tools: Cisco IOS CLI, PoE management, VLAN/QoS configuration tools, network monitoring, and bandwidth/latency testing utilities.

  • Automation & Operations Tools: Ansible, Python, CMDB systems, configuration backup tools, and documentation/diagramming platforms for global 24x7 operations.

Salary Range

50,640.00 - 63,300.00 EUR (Annual)

  • Further, the salary information noted above is a range that consists of a minimum and maximum rate of pay for this specific position. Where an applicant or employee is placed on this range will depend and be contingent on objective, documented work-related considerations like education, experience, certifications, licenses, preferred qualifications, among other factors.

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Job Description:

Director, Affordability

Alpine Physician Partners | Remote-Flexible

The Role

This role is responsible for owning and driving Alpine's medical expense reduction program across all markets. Working in close partnership with the Chief Clinical Officer, you will take clinical programs from concept through full operational deployment; help build, support and manage a portfolio of clinical and operational interventions; lead vendor (those that support and accelerate affordability programs) selection and performance management; and construct the measurement infrastructure to track both program execution progress and financial impact at the program and PMPM (patient/membership) level.

What You Will Own

  • MedEx framework ownership. In partnership with the Chief Clinical Officer, develop and maintain a framework for identifying, sizing, prioritizing, and implementing interventions that drive PMPM medical expense reduction across the full member population.

  • Vendor programs and management. Lead vendor evaluation, selection, contracting, and ongoing performance management with Alpine vendors designed to accelerate and appropriately manage/reduce unnecessary medical spend. Hold vendors accountable to real-world admission reduction benchmarks. Where appropriate, interface with internal technology team to ensure appropriate technology specifications and safeguards have been evaluated and implemented.

  • Chronic and complex disease management, Advanced life and palliative care planning, and Hospice-appropriate care. Own and drive clinical program deployment across Alpine’s advanced illness portfolio, including hospice, palliative care, and disease management programs such as CHF and complex chronic condition management. Lead programs through the full lifecycle: clinical design, clinician and site engagement, patient identification and activation, vendor acceleration where applicable, and ongoing performance management. Ensure clinic-level workflows and patient touchpoints are operational, not just contracted.

  • Hospital divergence and ED diversion. Design and manage programs to reduce avoidable admissions, readmissions and ED utilization in partnership with regional operations leads and clinic teams.

  • Referral integrity and specialty utilization. Partner with Market CMOs and clinic teams to implement referral integrity review at the point of order, ensuring appropriate use of specialty referrals, differential utilization of high-value and in-network specialist, optimizing internal and curb-side consultation when appropriate routing, and ultimately reducing unnecessary specialty spend. Where appropriate, support in the JOC (joint operating committee) meetings with network specialists, and/or support the financial modeling of alternative payment strategies such as sub-capitation of the high-value and in-network specialists.

  • Program KPI framework, ROI tracking, and cross-functional reporting: Working with business analytics team, serve as the business owner (along with the Chief Clinical Officer) to own Alpine’s MedEx measurement and reporting infrastructure, with a two-layer reporting cadence: (1) leading indicators of program execution—enrollment velocity, clinician activation rates, vendor milestone adherence, patient touchpoint completion—that signal whether programs are on track before financial results materialize; and (2) lagging financial impact measures—intervention-level PMPM savings, program ROI, utilization rate trends (admissions, ED visits, SNF days), and cost-per-member-per-program. Partner with IT/Data and Business Analytics to build the data infrastructure and with Finance to validate methodology and integrate into board- and investor-facing performance reporting.

What We Are Looking For

  • Demonstrated track record driving medical cost improvement in a full-risk Medicare Advantage or value-based care setting; experience with both plan-side affordability programs and provider-side utilization management is a strong differentiator

  • Demonstrated ability to drive clinical programs from concept to live operations, including engaging clinicians and site teams, activating patients, managing vendor partnerships to accelerate program maturity, and delivering against defined utilization and financial targets; experience with hospice, advanced illness, CHF or other disease management programs highly valued

  • Ability to evaluate vendors rigorously, including building financial models, stress-testing assumptions, and holding partners accountable to real-world ROI rather than published estimates

  • Strong cross-functional operator: equally effective engaging frontline clinicians and clinic site teams as partnering with IT on data infrastructure and Finance on ROI methodology and reporting; able to manage central program execution while staying close to the ground-level realities that determine whether programs actually land

  • Data-driven approach to prioritization and decision-making; able to build or direct the build of PMPM-level cost impact models and intervention tracking infrastructure

  • Experience working across network, clinical, and finance functions to design and execute cost reduction strategies in a multi-market environment

Preferred Background

  • Clinical fluency sufficient to design workflows, engage clinical teams with credibility, and evaluate program design quality; a formal clinical credential (RN, LVN, or similar) is a plus but not required; MBA or MHA welcome where paired with meaningful clinical operations exposure

  • Background in Medicare Advantage plan affordability, value-based care operations, or health system utilization management

  • Familiarity with MSSP program mechanics and dual MA/ACO operating environments

  • Experience building or scaling a MedEx or affordability function

Salary Range:

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
