raw.description:
Customer Success Manager (CSM / Account Manager) – SaaS, Renewals & Growth | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success Manager (CSM) / Account Manager to own client relationships, drive product adoption, protect revenue, and identify opportunities for account growth.

This is not a support-only role. You’ll manage a portfolio of 20–40 client accounts and take ownership of the customer lifecycle — from onboarding and adoption through renewals and expansion.

You’ll proactively identify at-risk accounts, conduct strategic client conversations, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure customers consistently see measurable value.

If you think in terms of retention, expansion, adoption, and client outcomes, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Customer Onboarding & Product Adoption

  • Lead new client onboarding and establish clear success criteria
  • Configure accounts and guide customers through implementation
  • Deliver product training and onboarding sessions
  • Monitor early-stage usage and adoption
  • Identify adoption gaps and proactively address them
  • Ensure customers reach value quickly after implementation

Account & Relationship Management

  • Manage a portfolio of 20–40 client accounts
  • Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Conduct regular client check-ins and strategic account reviews
  • Understand each client’s goals, challenges, and business priorities
  • Maintain clear communication and accountability across accounts

Client Health & Proactive Engagement

  • Monitor customer usage, engagement, and health indicators
  • Use platforms such as Gainsight, ChurnZero, or Totango to track account health
  • Identify at-risk accounts before they become churn risks
  • Execute structured re-engagement and retention playbooks
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)
  • Connect product usage and outcomes to measurable client ROI

Support Coordination & Escalations

  • Triage customer issues and coordinate internal resolution
  • Partner with product, technical, and support teams
  • Own client communication throughout escalations
  • Follow issues through to complete resolution
  • Ensure customers remain informed and confident during complex situations
  • Identify recurring issues and help improve the overall customer experience

Renewals, Retention & Expansion

  • Own renewal timelines and maintain visibility into upcoming renewals
  • Drive strong retention across assigned accounts
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Collaborate with sales on expansion opportunities
  • Prepare renewal documentation and coordinate contract processes
  • Proactively address risks that could impact renewals
  • Look for opportunities to increase customer value and account growth

Reporting & Customer Feedback

  • Maintain accurate CRM and customer-success records
  • Track:
    • Client health
    • Product usage
    • Renewal status
    • Churn risks
    • Expansion opportunities
  • Capture customer feedback and communicate insights to internal teams
  • Partner with product teams to surface recurring customer needs
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into portfolio health and revenue risks

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • 2–3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role
  • Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts
  • Proven experience driving renewals and customer retention
  • Experience with Salesforce or HubSpot
  • Familiarity with customer success platforms such as:
    • Gainsight
    • ChurnZero
    • Totango
  • Strong presentation and client communication skills
  • Experience conducting QBRs, demos, onboarding sessions, or client reviews
  • Ability to identify and manage at-risk accounts
  • Strong organizational and account-management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • 3–5 years of CSM or Account Management experience
  • Experience carrying retention, renewal, or expansion targets
  • Background in SaaS, B2B technology, or professional services
  • Experience with NPS, CSAT, and customer health scoring
  • Experience identifying and closing upsell or cross-sell opportunities
  • Experience building:
    • Customer success playbooks
    • QBR decks
    • Account plans
    • Case studies
  • Experience working directly with executives and senior client stakeholders

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think in terms of revenue retention and expansion, not just customer support
  • You proactively identify risks rather than waiting for customers to complain
  • You can balance customer advocacy with business outcomes
  • You communicate confidently with both day-to-day users and executives
  • You understand how to turn product adoption into measurable customer value
  • You can manage multiple accounts without losing visibility or follow-through
  • You take ownership of problems through resolution
  • You are comfortable being accountable for renewals and client health

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing customer-health dashboards for at-risk accounts, upcoming renewals, and expansion opportunities.

From there, you might lead an onboarding session, conduct a QBR with an existing client, coordinate with product or support on an escalation, prepare an account strategy for an upcoming renewal, and update CRM records and health scores.

In short: you ensure customers adopt the product, see value, renew, and grow.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR): ≥100%
  • Renewal Rate: ≥90–95%
  • Expansion and upsell revenue
  • Customer adoption and engagement
  • Client health score improvement
  • Churn reduction
  • NPS / CSAT performance
  • Onboarding success and time-to-value
  • Accuracy of CRM and account reporting

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct ownership of customer retention and revenue growth
  • High-impact role across customer success, product, and sales
  • Strong exposure to client strategy and decision-makers
  • Opportunity to build meaningful, long-term customer relationships
  • Clear performance metrics tied to business outcomes
  • Growth opportunities into Senior CSM, Strategic Account Management, Customer Success Leadership, or Revenue Operations
  • Fully remote environment with structured expectations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Task – QBR / Account Strategy Scenario
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you’re a Customer Success Manager who builds strong client relationships, proactively prevents churn, and thinks in terms of adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and take ownership of helping customers see value, stay, and grow.

raw.description:
Quality Engineer II (Warranty Management)

SUMMARY

The BESS Quality Engineer II (Warranty Management) is responsible for leading the end-to-end administration of warranty claims across utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role serves as the primary point of contact for customers, operations teams, subcontractors, and suppliers throughout the warranty period, ensuring that all warranty requests are properly evaluated, prioritized, assigned, and resolved in a timely manner. The Warranty Manager drives accountability across stakeholders and maintains oversight of the warranty portfolio to ensure claims are closed efficiently while protecting customer relationships and controlling warranty costs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the intake, triage, and tracking of all BESS warranty claims from initial notification through final closeout.
  • Ensure warranty requests contain the required documentation, troubleshooting records, photos, and supporting information necessary for evaluation and disposition.
  • Review incoming claims for warranty eligibility and coordinate with project teams, suppliers, OEMs, subcontractors, and field operations to determine corrective actions.
  • Assign resources and drive execution of repair, replacement, or remediation activities.
  • Maintain ownership of claim status, ensuring timely follow-up, escalation, and resolution of open items.
  • Lead communication with customers and O&M teams, providing regular updates on claim progress, corrective actions, and expected closure dates.
  • Monitor warranty response times, aging claims, and performance metrics to ensure service level expectations are achieved.
  • Maintain accurate records within warranty management systems and develop reporting on claim volume, status, root causes, recurring issues, and budgets.
  • Identify trends, serial defects, and systemic equipment issues and coordinate corrective action plans with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Partner with project teams during project closeout and warranty handoff activities to ensure complete turnover of documentation, warranties, supplier contacts, and operational requirements.
  • Verify completion of corrective actions and obtain customer or O&M confirmation prior to formally closing warranty events.
  • Continuously improve warranty processes, workflows, and reporting to enhance customer experience and reduce claim cycle times.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction, Civil, or Architectural Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience

  • Minimum of two years’ experience within the design, engineering, construction, or other related industries

  • Possess good mechanical aptitude and develop knowledge in use of large cranes, mechanical systems, and utility based medium and high voltage electrical systems

  • Strong understanding of optical fiber installation, standards and best practices for inside plant and outside plant

  • Understanding of the design-bid-build process.

  • Self-starter, independent worker, computer literate

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills

  • Strong teamwork orientation

  • Basic knowledge of construction processes, systems, and project management

  • Current driver’s license

  • Openness to travel

A few benefits offered include:

(for Non-Craft & Non-Union Craft working 25+ hours / week)

  • Medical and prescription drug plans that includes no additional cost vision coverage

  • Dental plan

  • 401k retirement plan with a generous Mortenson match

  • Paid time off, holidays, and other paid leaves

  • Employer paid Life, AD&D, and disability insurance

  • No-Cost mental health tool and concierge with extensive work-life resources

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Gym Membership Discount Program

**The base pay range for this role is $89,500 MIN - $120,800 MAX. (Actual range is higher for the following office locations: Denver, CO and Chicago, IL – 5%, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR – 10%, Washington, D.C. – 12.5%).

Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience, with consideration given to internal equity. This position is eligible for Mortenson’s incentive plan.

  • Our postings are typically open a minimum of 5 days and an average of 44 days.

As a top builder, developer, and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), our expertise spans markets like sports, renewable energy, data centers, healthcare, and more. We are builders at heart, working to ensure the built environment has a lasting positive impact.

raw.title: Business Analyst - NOAA Fisheries
raw.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.
raw.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is seeking a Business Analyst with deep expertise in NOAA Fisheries (the National Marine Fisheries Service, the federal agency within NOAA responsible for managing and conserving U.S. marine resources) data systems and consultation processes to serve as the dedicated NOAA Fisheries liaison on a federal data integration program. You will ensure NOAA Fisheries requirements are accurately captured, data systems are properly documented, and all required approvals are obtained throughout the project.

Work Location: Remote

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the dedicated SME for NOAA Fisheries business processes, data systems, and stakeholder coordination
  • Document NOAA Fisheries-specific consultation requirements including marine and anadromous species regulatory requirements, Critical Habitat designations, and listing status standards
  • Elicit and document NOAA Fisheries data system requirements including authoritative source identification, data access pathways, refresh cadences, and data stewardship contacts
  • Coordinate with NOAA Fisheries SMEs to obtain approval on schema harmonization decisions and ensure all data modifications are authorized
  • Facilitate iterative range map review cycles with NOAA Fisheries SMEs and coordinate input on map accuracy and completeness
  • Support development of NOAA Fisheries-specific decision logic and template content requirements
  • Coordinate NOAA Fisheries co-signature on the ESA Section 7 Compliance Validation Checklist
  • Facilitate NOAA Fisheries partner office participation in pilot consultation workflows
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Peraton team and NOAA Fisheries

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree and 8 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 6 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 10 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 14 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • Demonstrated years of experience in business analysis or program support on federal environmental or marine science programs
  • Strong understanding of ESA Section 7 consultation processes for marine and anadromous species

  • Experience facilitating government stakeholder reviews and obtaining formal approvals

  • Excellent written communication skills; experience producing government-facing documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience working with or supporting NOAA Fisheries operations or data systems

  • Direct experience with NOAA Fisheries authoritative data systems or marine species databases

  • Experience coordinating multi-agency deliverable approvals (FWS + NOAA Fisheries)

  • Familiarity with federal data governance standards and OCIO-authorized data pathways

    CBAP or equivalent BA certification

  • Active Public Trust Clearance

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

raw.title: Freelance Brand Designer
raw.excerpt: Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (** and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products.
raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (** and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
  • Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
  • Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
  • Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
  • Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
  • Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
  • Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

Additional requirements

  • A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
  • Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
  • Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Location: This position is based in Brussels, Belgium (remote).

Position Summary:

As Manager EU Government Relations, you will support the Senior Director EU Government Relations to develop and manage Bentley’s relationships with policymakers at EU and national level. Your mission will be to ensure that EU public policy supports our sustainable growth in Europe, and that we remain a trusted partner to policymakers. You feel at home at the intersection of law, politics, and business, and will elevate Bentley’s participation in debates around digitalization of infrastructure (with a primary focus on energy and mining-related discussions).

Responsibilities:

  • Represent Bentley in emerging policy debates and regulatory developments related to digitalization of infrastructure, including through meetings with policymakers at EU and national level. Focus on energy infrastructure, though role will also involve other topics (e.g. mining, critical raw materials, subsurface data, climate resilience).
  • Monitor a select number of “horizontal” policy topics impacting Bentley’s business. These can include AI and machine learning, cybersecurity, public procurement, personal and non-personal data.
  • Lead Bentley’s Government Relations advocacy in one key market at EU level, depending on profile of successful candidate.
  • With guidance from the Senior Director EU Government Relations, manage and execute public policy-related projects and support Bentley’s advocacy toward policymakers. Enable and coordinate meetings with key stakeholders (external and internal) to reach set advocacy goals.
  • Represent Bentley in relevant trade/industry associations and events, and help drive Bentley’s objectives.
  • Produce and manage government relations content and collateral for outward-facing meetings. Content shall include presentations, one-pagers, and deeper substantive papers on how Bentley’s technology is improving quality of life and making infrastructure more sustainable and resilient.
  • Brief, prep. collaborate with and advise Bentley colleagues on EU policy matters as needed (e.g. Sales, Legal, Communications).

Qualifications:

  • Four to seven years of government relations work in Brussels, in-house or for a relevant public institution, industry group, or consultancy.
  • Experience leading engagements with EU policymakers and executing public policy-related projects. Self-starter with the ability to understand business needs, think strategically and develop creative and constructive policy proposals.
  • Excellent knowledge of the EU political and legislative process and an existing network of key stakeholders in Brussels and/or at national level.
  • Good understanding of digital policy, in particular issues related to digitalization of energy infrastructure.
  • The ability to effectively communicate – and advocate – for Bentley’s policy positions. Strong writing and analytical skills.
  • Basic understanding of EU infrastructure funding programs and their execution at national level, and willingness to deepen this knowledge.
  • Ability to work as part of a team, with a high degree of self-awareness, integrity, and accountability.
  • Master’s degree in law, public policy, political science or similar, or equivalent training or experience.
  • Excellent command of English and at least one other EU language.
  • Some travel required (10-15%).

What We Offer:

  • A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video. 
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start. 
  • An attractive salary and benefits package. 
  • A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. 
  • A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

About Bentley Systems:

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance.

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

Who We Are

At RelationalAI, we’re solving one of the most important challenges in artificial intelligence: how to teach large language models the logic, semantics, and business context of the modern enterprise.

Frontier models are trained almost entirely on public data — they can speak about the world, but they don’t understand your business. We fix that.

RelationalAI has pioneered a breakthrough called Superalignment — technology that enables LLMs to learn natively from private, structured enterprise data inside the data cloud.

By combining this with relational knowledge graphs and our proprietary neuro/symbolic-relational reasoners, we deliver trustworthy decision intelligence: systems that use semantic models to truly understand how a business operates and can reason across its data to drive better outcomes.

We’re a globally distributed team of engineers, scientists, and builders redefining how AI learns from data. We believe that high-stakes decisions deserve frontier intelligence — intelligence that’s explainable, aligned, and grounded in reality.

raw.description:
Job Description: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate is a software engineer with a passion for quality who can design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation solutions while collaborating closely with software developers, DevOps engineers, product managers, and QA professionals.

The SDET will play a key role in ensuring software quality throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) by building robust automation frameworks, developing testing tools, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, and promoting quality engineering best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks.

Develop automated test scripts for Web, Mobile, Desktop, API, and Microservices applications.

Create data-driven, keyword-driven, hybrid, and behavior-driven (BDD) automation frameworks.

Continuously improve automation coverage and execution efficiency.

Software Development

Write clean, maintainable, and production-quality code using modern programming languages.

Develop custom testing utilities, libraries, and tools to improve testing productivity.

Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.

Refactor automation code to improve maintainability and scalability.

API & Backend Testing

Design and automate RESTful and GraphQL API testing.

Validate request/response payloads, authentication, authorization, and business logic.

Perform database validations using SQL and NoSQL databases.

Develop reusable API testing libraries.

Continuous Integration & DevOps

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

Configure and maintain automated test execution in Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

Analyze pipeline failures and improve test reliability.

Support shift-left testing practices.

Quality Engineering

Participate in requirement analysis, design reviews, and sprint planning.

Identify quality risks early in the SDLC.

Develop comprehensive test strategies and test plans.

Improve application testability through collaboration with developers.

Drive quality metrics and automation adoption.

Performance & Security Testing

Support performance, load, stress, and scalability testing.

Assist with security and vulnerability validation where applicable.

Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

Test Data & Environment Management

Create and maintain reusable test data.

Manage automated test environments.

Support service virtualization and test environment stability.

Agile Collaboration

Participate in Scrum ceremonies.

Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Architects.

Provide accurate effort estimates for automation tasks.

Mentor junior engineers and promote quality engineering practices.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Monitor automation execution results.

Analyze failures and perform root cause analysis.

Maintain automation dashboards and quality metrics.

Recommend process improvements to increase product quality and delivery speed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

5+ years of experience in software testing and automation.

Strong software development experience.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and collaboration abilities.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with distributed systems and microservices.

Experience testing cloud-native applications.

Knowledge of containerized environments.

Familiarity with infrastructure as code.

Experience with AI-assisted testing tools and intelligent test automation.

Understanding of secure software development practices.

Soft Skills

Strong software engineering mindset.

Passion for quality and continuous improvement.

Excellent debugging and troubleshooting abilities.

Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Strong ownership and accountability.

Ability to mentor and guide team members.

Effective stakeholder communication.

Adaptability in fast-paced Agile environments.

Success Metrics

An SDET will be considered successful by:

Increasing automation coverage.

Reducing regression execution time.

Improving CI/CD pipeline reliability.

Reducing escaped defects.

Improving automation framework maintainability.

Enhancing application testability.

Reducing flaky tests.

Improving release quality and deployment confidence.

raw.description:
As our Research & Development Field Account Manager Strategic Accounts, you will build trusted relationships within key strategic accounts, create early visibility into emerging molecule programs, and support the adoption of technologies that enable scientific progress. This field-based position supports strategic customer accounts and is remotely based in New Jersey or Pennsylvania, offering the opportunity to work closely with leading biopharma organizations while contributing to better health for more people.

Grow with us – Your Responsibilities

  • Build sustained relationships with scientific and managerial stakeholders across Strategic Account R&D sites to increase access, trust, and visibility into molecule programs, discovery activities, and R&D process decisions

  • Map and maintain molecule pipeline visibility by tracking program status, site footprints, and upcoming decision points from discovery through R&D to enable timely technology seeding and opportunity creation

  • Identify and prioritize early-stage technology seeding opportunities by translating R&D process needs and discovery-stage requirements into defined use cases and aligning appropriate Business Unit technical experts to support validation activities across new molecules, processes, and modalities

  • Drive validation of selected technologies through process and product trials, including scale-up, scale-down, and manufacturing-sensitive validation activities, while documenting outcomes and readiness signals that support progression toward pilot, clinical, or manufacturing adoption

  • Support pilot and clinical-phase (Phase I-III) process and product trials by enabling process optimization, validation activities, and manufacturing readiness in collaboration with Product Development, Tech Transfer, and CMO partners

  • Monitor the evolving process landscape within assigned accounts by identifying new processes, transfers, and modalities and proactively highlighting footprint changes, risks, and business implications to relevant internal stakeholders

  • Execute structured handovers of validated programs by providing stakeholder maps, process context, validation evidence, and recommended next steps to commercial teams

What will convince us

  • Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, or a comparable scientific discipline

  • 3+ years of experience in customer-facing roles within biopharma environments, including process development support, technical sales, applications, or scientific support, with strong exposure to R&D environments

  • Demonstrate the ability to operate credibly within highly scientific settings and translate early-stage R&D requirements into structured validation and technology adoption pathways

  • Communicate confidently with diverse senior decision makers and collaborate effectively with Technical Sales teams to shape complex customer solutions

  • Manage stakeholders successfully across customer R&D networks and cross-functional internal organizations

  • Utilize CRM systems, including SFDC, and maintain disciplined documentation practices for pipeline management, customer process tracking, validation evidence, and decision-point management

  • Demonstrate willingness to travel more than 50% to support customer engagement and field-based activities

  • Identify with Sartorius' core values of Sustainability, Openness, and Enjoyment

Travel required to visit customer sites within the US and potential for international travel for business meetings.

What We Offer

As a growing global life science company, with our stock listed on the German DAX and TecDAX , Sartorius offers a wide range of benefits:
Personal and Professional Development: Mentoring, leadership programs, internal seminar offerings
Worklife Balance: Paid vacation, sick time, corporate holidays and community service day; as well as flexible work schedules
Making an Impact Right from the Start: Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform
Welcoming Culture: Mutual support, team spirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics such as “Coaching”, “Agile Working” and a “Businesswomen’s Network”
Health & Well Being: Wide selection of health and well-being support such as a variety of medical plans to choose from, dental, vision, EAP, and other wellness programs.
Intelligent Working Environment: Working in smart buildings with the latest technology and equipment.

Retirement Savings Plan: 401 k (with generous company match)
Flexible Spending: HSA, FSA (dependent care & healthcare spending), Transportation Commuter Account
Company Paid Benefits: Basic Life Insurance, AD&D, EAP, Family Planning & Women’s Health, Health Advocate
Additional/Optional: Supplemental Life Insurance (employee, spouse & dependents), Legal Services, LTD & STD, Critical Illness Insurance, Student Loan Tuition Refinance Service

raw.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy:

Job Description:

Solventum, a new healthcare company with a rich history
We’re a new company built on a trusted legacy of solving big healthcare challenges that improve patient lives while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. People, and their well-being, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue. We partner closely with the best minds in healthcare — guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence — to solve our customers’ toughest challenges.

Our ultimate goal? Move humanity forward by improving health for everyone. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The impact you’ll make in this role

As an AceraSenior Account Executive, you’ll work alongside sharp, inquisitive minds from a wide spectrum of backgrounds and disciplines. Together, you'll explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and shape solutions that make a real-world impact by:

  • Managing and growing sales of assigned products within a defined geographic territory, with accountability for meeting or exceeding revenue and growth objectives.
  • Developing and executing territory business plans, including clinical education, customer engagement, and account prioritization strategies.
  • Building and sustaining trusted relationships with surgeons, clinicians, and decision-makers across multiple hospital departments and sites of care.
  • Delivering compliant product demonstrations, in-servicing, and clinical support while ensuring accurate forecasting, reporting, and inventory management

Driving Requirements:

This position requires the use of a personal vehicle for company business and participation in Solventum’s Fixed and Variable Reimbursement (FAVR) program. As a condition of employment, candidates must successfully complete a pre-hire motor vehicle record (MVR) review and maintain ongoing eligibility, including compliance with Solventum’s driver policy, insurance requirements, and annual policy sign-off. Ongoing monitoring of motor vehicle history will be conducted.

Your skills and expertise

These are the core capabilities and experiences essential to make an impact:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher from an accredited university and 5+ years of experience in medical device, pharmaceutical sales, or medical field sales

OR

  • High School Diploma/GED AND 9+ years’ experience in medical device, pharmaceutical sales, or medical field sales
  • Current, valid Driver’s License.

Nice to Have” Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage time and priorities independently while adapting quickly in a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including effective people management, conflict resolution, and project coordination under pressure.
  • Proven analytical and organizational capabilities to assess information, identify priorities, and execute with accuracy.
  • Track record of building and maintaining productive relationships with physicians and surgical staff in a sales or clinical setting.
  • Effective negotiation, selling, and presentation skills, with working proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Concur

Additional Requirements

In this role, you may be required to enter healthcare or other third-party facilities. Those facilities may, in turn, require you to possess certain licenses, vaccinations, and/or other credentials or qualifications (collectively “prerequisites to entry”) for regulatory, safety, or other business reasons. All information will be kept in accordance with applicable law and Solventum policies. In order to respond to the prerequisites to entry, Solventum may share your information with the providers of medical screens, vaccinations, or verifications as well as the healthcare or other third-party facilities requiring the prerequisites to entry.

Work Location

  • Remote: Within Omaha, NE

Travel: May include up to 90% travel within sales territory
Relocation Assistance:May be authorized

Pay Transparency

Applicable to US Applicants Only: The base salary range for this position is $95,000.00 with additional commission opportunities based on role eligibility and performance.

This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at:

Legal & Compliance

Must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status.

Where this role fits

This role sits within Solventum’s Medical Surgical Division, supporting the Acera product portfolio and its clinically proven solutions designed to improve patient outcomes and surgical efficiency. Through Acera Surgical and the Restrata product, the team advances evidence‑based wound care technologies that support healing across multiple surgical specialties, helping frontline healthcare providers deliver safer, more effective care.

title: Organic Growth Specialist
description: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

raw.title: Organic Growth Specialist
raw.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
raw.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role

Own organic and AI-search performance across Sleek's four core markets and convert that visibility into leads. The primary KPI is to generate leads from organic and AI traffic and convert into new customers. This role exists to fix the conversion gap the current setup can't: our funnel is constrained by lead conversion, not traffic — the two failing markets (AU, UK) fall short on target because visitors don't convert, not because pages don't rank.

Key outcomes In the first 6–12 months

Outcome 1: Grow leads through high-intent traffic

Lift monthly leads to the +15% stretch requirement by March 2027 — SG ~446, HK ~223, AU ~134, UK ~146 — by growing qualified organic + AI traffic to commercial/service pages ~10–15% above current trajectory and winning the high-intent, transactional queries that bring buyers.

Traffic growth here is in service of lead volume on pages that convert — not informational traffic that doesn't.

Identify the high-intent commercial/transactional queries where Sleek's service pages under-rank, and close those gaps.

Fix cannibalization where informational blogs absorb traffic owed to commercial pages; consolidate or re-point intent.

Build internal-linking and funnel paths from informational content to the commercial pages that convert.

Prioritise commercial-page visibility and lead capture over raw informational traffic.

Outcome 2: Lift site-user-to-lead conversion

Land the four markets on the 15% stretch by March 2027 to SG ~1.29×, HK ~1.26×, AU ~1.85×, UK ~1.05× on current lead rate — moving combined Organic+AI attainment to ~92–100% of target with December as mid-point check.

Establish per-market conversion baselines and instrument site-user→lead tracking across all four sites.

Diagnose drop-off on the highest-traffic non-converting pages; prioritise CRO reworks over new content.

Own the AU conversion-recovery investigation (1.3%→0.6% drop) as a first-90-days deliverable.

Ship structured CRO fixes (CTAs, form friction, intent alignment, page structure) with product and engineering.

Report baseline, test results and per-market progress monthly.

Outcome 3: Grow new customers from AI/LLM-referred discovery

+50% new customers attributable to AI/LLM-referred traffic vs current baseline by March 2027, plus a lift in AI citation / share-of-voice on priority tracked queries.

Audit site structure, schema and content for LLM extractability gaps.

Strengthen E-E-A-T, structured content and citeable formatting on priority pages.

Track brand citation and AI-referral attribution monthly (PEEC/Bing AI tracking is still maturing — expect to harden measurement).

Build the AI-visibility reporting the team currently lacks.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience across technical, on-page and off-page SEO, managing a large page inventory in a B2B or eCommerce organisation.
  • Proven CRO impact with quantified outcomes, specifically improving site-user→lead / funnel conversion rather than only improving rankings or traffic.
  • Hands-on experience building and scaling programmatic SEO using data-driven, templated pages across large page inventories.
  • Deep technical SEO experience, including Core Web Vitals, structured data / JSON-LD schema, site architecture, crawl budget, and indexation.
  • Applied AI-search / GEO experience with measurable outcomes, including experience with brand-citation tracking, AI-referral analysis, and structuring pages for LLM extraction.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building AI-driven workflows, automations or agents for SEO, CRO, analytics or related marketing processes.
  • Strong experience with behavioural-analytics tools such as Microsoft Clarity and Hotjar and CRM platforms such as HubSpot; GA4 and GSC assumed baseline.
  • Proven ability to work directly with Product and Engineering teams to get SEO and CRO changes shipped, rather than working through an account-management layer.
  • Experience in a considered-purchase / professional-services category such as fintech, legal, accounting, compliance, or B2B services is preferred.

Must-have attributes

Conversion-driven: Optimises for leads and new customers; treats rankings and traffic as means, not end.

Ownership: Accountable for conversion performance and revenue impact across markets.

Systems thinker: Understands how traffic, conversion, AI visibility and content interact — and builds systems across them.

Structured Thinking: Prioritises across four markets, many services, and competing levers.

Data Driven: Diagnoses with data; distinguishes signal from noise; doesn't act on single-month blips.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to challenge assumptions, communicate clearly, and work constructively with stakeholders when priorities or approaches differ.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

  • Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  • Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  • Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  • Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview and a TA screen with the member of the Hiring Tam

AI Assessment: Candidates who pass TA screening will be invited to complete an AI assessment. Candidates will have 3 days to complete the assessment, after which the hiring team will review the submission and determine whether to progress the candidate to the technical skills round.

Technical Round: A ~60–90 minute live test conducted by the Hiring Manager to assess SEO, CRO, technical SEO, AI-search/GEO knowledge, data-driven problem solving, and the ability to prioritise and execute against commercial outcomes.

Soft Skills Round: A ~60 minute interview conducted by Head of E-commerce to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

Your education

Any criminal history

Any political exposure

Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

Ship structured CRO fixes (CTAs, form friction, intent alignment, page structure) with product and engineering.

Report baseline, test results and per-market progress monthly.

Outcome 3: Grow new customers from AI/LLM-referred discovery

+50% new customers attributable to AI/LLM-referred traffic vs current baseline by March 2027, plus a lift in AI citation / share-of-voice on priority tracked queries.

Audit site structure, schema and content for LLM extractability gaps.

Strengthen E-E-A-T, structured content and citeable formatting on priority pages.

Track brand citation and AI-referral attribution monthly (PEEC/Bing AI tracking is still maturing — expect to harden measurement).

Build the AI-visibility reporting the team currently lacks.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience across technical, on-page and off-page SEO, managing a large page inventory in a B2B or eCommerce organisation.
  • Proven CRO impact with quantified outcomes, specifically improving site-user→lead / funnel conversion rather than only improving rankings or traffic.
  • Hands-on experience building and scaling programmatic SEO using data-driven, templated pages across large page inventories.
  • Deep technical SEO experience, including Core Web Vitals, structured data / JSON-LD schema, site architecture, crawl budget, and indexation.
  • Applied AI-search / GEO experience with measurable outcomes, including experience with brand-citation tracking, AI-referral analysis, and structuring pages for LLM extraction.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building AI-driven workflows, automations or agents for SEO, CRO, analytics or related marketing processes.
  • Strong experience with behavioural-analytics tools such as Microsoft Clarity and Hotjar and CRM platforms such as HubSpot; GA4 and GSC assumed baseline.
  • Proven ability to work directly with Product and Engineering teams to get SEO and CRO changes shipped, rather than working through an account-management layer.
  • Experience in a considered-purchase / professional-services category such as fintech, legal, accounting, compliance, or B2B services is preferred.

Must-have attributes

Conversion-driven: Optimises for leads and new customers; treats rankings and traffic as means, not end.

Ownership: Accountable for conversion performance and revenue impact across markets.

Systems thinker: Understands how traffic, conversion, AI visibility and content interact — and builds systems across them.

Structured Thinking: Prioritises across four markets, many services, and competing levers.

Data Driven: Diagnoses with data; distinguishes signal from noise; doesn't act on single-month blips.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to challenge assumptions, communicate clearly, and work constructively with stakeholders when priorities or approaches differ.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

  • Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  • Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  • Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  • Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview and a TA screen with the member of the Hiring Tam

AI Assessment: Candidates who pass TA screening will be invited to complete an AI assessment. Candidates will have 3 days to complete the assessment, after which the hiring team will review the submission and determine whether to progress the candidate to the technical skills round.

Technical Round: A ~60–90 minute live test conducted by the Hiring Manager to assess SEO, CRO, technical SEO, AI-search/GEO knowledge, data-driven problem solving, and the ability to prioritise and execute against commercial outcomes.

Soft Skills Round: A ~60 minute interview conducted by Head of E-commerce to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

Your education

Any criminal history

Any political exposure

Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

As Localization QA Game Tester, you will work within our Localization Quality Assurance team and be the very first person to see the localized game in its entirety – translated text, images and the rest of the user interface collectively. You’ll get to experience the project in the way it will be consumed by the end users. You will work in a multilingual project team ensuring that the game is free from grammatical errors, cultural inconsistencies and ultimately ensuring that the game is accurately localized into the target language.

Our Localization QA team conducts language checks on upcoming games across a variety of cutting-edge platforms, including PC, Xbox Series X/S, PS5, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation VR2, and various mobile and tablet devices. As an LQA Game Tester, you will be working on top gaming titles for some of the world’s leading publishers.

Front Desk & Admin Support, Insurance Verification & PA

Remote | Gastroenterology Practice | 40 hours/week | $5-$6/hour
Schedule: 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Central Time

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Virtual Medical Assistant & Patient Scheduling Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based gastroenterology practice.

This is a hybrid patient-facing and clinical administrative role. Your initial focus will be patient calls, scheduling, appointment coordination, and front-desk support. As you become familiar with the practice, your responsibilities may expand into broader Medical Assistant and provider-support functions.

The ideal candidate has experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice, is confident communicating directly with patients and providers, and has hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW).

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Calls, Scheduling & Front Desk Support

  • Manage inbound and outbound patient calls, respond to basic inquiries, and follow up on appointment requests and prospective patient leads.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate new patient visits, follow-ups, procedures, and surgical appointments in eClinicalWorks (eCW).

  • Monitor patient communications across phone, email, and text, including appointment reminders, preparation instructions, scheduling changes, and other follow-up needs.

2. Medical Assistant & Provider Support

  • Support Physicians and Nurse Practitioners with chart preparation, intake information, medical documentation, and other remote clinical administrative tasks.

  • Assist with new prescription requests, medication refill requests, and related documentation according to established clinic protocols.

  • Track laboratory, pathology, and diagnostic results and appropriately communicate or route information to providers and patients as directed.

3. Insurance Verification & Prior Authorization

  • Verify patient insurance coverage and accurately document relevant benefits and coverage information in the patient record.

  • Process and follow up on prior authorization requests for procedures, medications, visits, and other services as assigned.

  • Coordinate with patients, providers, and insurance representatives to obtain required information and resolve authorization or coverage-related issues.

4. Workflow Documentation & Team Collaboration

  • Document clinic-specific scheduling, communication, and administrative processes as you learn the practice's workflows.

  • Help develop clear SOPs and step-by-step procedures that can support consistent operations and future team expansion.

  • Maintain clear and timely communication with Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, schedulers, front-desk staff, and other members of the clinic team.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice

  • Experience performing both medical receptionist/front-desk and Medical Assistant-related administrative responsibilities

  • Hands-on eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience is required

  • Strong experience with patient scheduling and appointment coordination

  • Familiarity with prior authorizations, insurance verification, prescriptions/refills, and laboratory or diagnostic-result workflows

  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and documentation skills

  • Comfortable communicating directly with patients, providers, and clinic staff

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with the onsite team

  • Thursday or Friday availability may occasionally be required depending on patient volume and scheduling needs. Schedule changes will be communicated for at least a week if Thursday or Friday schedule is needed.

Tools & Systems

  • eClinicalWorks (eCW) for patient records, scheduling, and clinical documentation

  • net2phone for inbound and outbound patient calls

  • Clinic email and text messaging platforms

  • Secure VPN and other productivity and communication tools

raw.description:
Brief

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Recruitment Delivery Consultant to support our specialist recruitment team, with a primary focus on sourcing, engaging and qualifying candidates across technical and engineering markets.

This is a voice-based recruitment role, requiring someone who is confident speaking directly with candidates, able to build rapport quickly and capable of assessing candidate suitability against specialist vacancies.

You will work closely with senior recruitment consultants, providing a consistent flow of high-quality, qualified candidates for live and future opportunities.

The role combines proactive sourcing, candidate engagement, structured qualification and talent-pipeline development.

Client Details

Our client is a specialist recruitment business supporting organisations across technical, engineering and specialist professional markets.

The business has a strong focus on delivering high-quality recruitment solutions through a combination of specialist market knowledge, proactive talent identification and technology-enabled sourcing.

Responsibilities

Candidate Sourcing

  • Source relevant candidates for priority vacancies using LinkedIn Recruiter and other recruitment platforms.

  • Conduct targeted Boolean searches and proactive candidate identification.

  • Build and maintain candidate pipelines across agreed markets, locations, sectors and skill sets.

  • Identify passive candidates who may be suitable for current or future opportunities.

  • Complete market mapping and talent research projects where required.

Candidate Engagement

  • Create and manage targeted candidate outreach campaigns.

  • Proactively engage candidates through phone, Microsoft Teams, and email.

  • Make outbound candidate calls and establish rapport with potential candidates.

  • Introduce relevant opportunities and generate candidate interest.

  • Follow up consistently with candidates throughout the engagement process.

Candidate Qualification

  • Conduct structured candidate pre-screen and qualification calls.

  • Assess candidate experience, technical background, and suitability against specific vacancies.

  • Understand candidate motivations, career objectives, and reasons for considering a move.

  • Confirm availability, location, notice period, and compensation expectations.

  • Identify potential concerns or gaps against the recruitment brief.

  • Produce clear and accurate candidate summaries for senior consultants.

Consultant Support

  • Hand over qualified candidates to senior recruitment consultants with clear and relevant information.

  • Work closely with consultants to understand vacancy requirements and changing priorities.

  • Incorporate consultant feedback into future sourcing and qualification activity.

  • Support consultants with proactive talent-pipeline development for future recruitment requirements.

CRM & Administration

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and activity within the CRM.

  • Record candidate conversations, qualification notes, and follow-up actions.

  • Ensure candidate data and contact information remain accurate and up to date.

  • Consistently track sourcing, engagement, and qualification activity.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in recruitment, resourcing, candidate delivery or talent acquisition.

  • Experience sourcing candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter or comparable recruitment platforms.

  • Strong experience speaking directly with candidates and conducting qualification calls.

  • Demonstrable ability to assess candidate suitability against a defined recruitment brief.

  • Strong Boolean search and candidate identification skills.

  • Experience working within technical, engineering, robotics or specialist recruitment markets is advantageous.

  • Experience supporting US or European recruitment markets is beneficial.

  • Strong written and spoken English.

  • Experience working towards recruitment targets and delivering against live vacancies.

  • Ability to manage multiple vacancies, candidate conversations and priorities simultaneously.

You will be a practitioner on our telehealth platform 'Intellect', where your role is to support our clients' mental health and personal growth based on the individual needs and goals. This is delivered primarily through scheduled 30-minute video sessions on our platform.

This is a freelance remote role with the flexibility to decide your business hours. Local candidates are preferred but others can still be considered. This role is a great opportunity to supplement your current job or private practice.

We're seeking to partner with International Coaching Federation (ICF) Coaches, Clinical Psychologists, and counsellors to be part of a community working collaboratively to bring greater mental health access to the public to provide mental health coaching.

What You'll Do

  • Provide 1-on-1 telehealth professional or mental health coaching for Intellect’s clients
  • Focus on sub-clinical cases such as work stress, procrastination, work-life balance etc.
  • Support your clients in setting up either person or career goals, relationships, etc
  • Collaboratively work with the internal clinical team by suggesting improvements to the program and the platform.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Has an active International Coaching Federation Certification OR a Master / Postgraduate Diploma training in Counselling
  • Skilled in coaching techniques and/or evidence-based approaches (e.g. Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, DBT, SFBT, etc.)
  • ICF Coaches must have at least 200 coaching hours
  • Counsellors must have at least 300 clinical hours post graduation
  • Candidate must be proficient in English and local language
  • Candidates with prior experience in EAP, counselling working adults or coaching managerial roles are prioritised.

raw.description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started back in 2000, we have been striving to make the world’s most robust and effective developer tools. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.

We are working on an ambitious new platform that provides AI capabilities to all JetBrains products. Our platform is based on models developed in-house for writing and coding assistance, as well as integration with our strategic partners.

We are looking for a Research Engineer who can contribute to training foundation models for coding tasks. You’ll be working on developing Large Language Models from scratch and deploying them into production environments where they will be accessible by end users across the globe.

We value engineers who:

  • Can plan projects and make decisions independently, consulting with others if needed.
  • Identify customer needs and prioritize their tasks accordingly.
  • Start with the simplest solutions and gradually add complexity as needed.
  • Take sole responsibility for an entire subsystem.
  • Have a passion for learning and a desire to stay up to date with the latest developments in the LLM field.

In this role, you will:

  • Work with stakeholders to convert business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Train LLMs from scratch on a large GPU cluster.
  • Collect and process pre-training and fine-tuning datasets.
  • Support and improve existing subsystems.

We’ll be happy to have you on our team if you have:

  • Experience in design, deployment, and support of production ML systems.
  • A strong theoretical background in NLP and transformer-based approaches.
  • Proficiency with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and common libraries for NLP.
  • Experience in distributed training of multi-billion parameter models.
  • Attention to detail in everything you do and great communication skills.

We’d be especially thrilled if you have experience with:

  • LLM inference frameworks such as vLLM, DeepSpeed, TensorRT.
  • LLM alignment techniques such as RLHF/RLAIF.
  • MLOps tools and practices, including CI/CD for ML.
  • K8s and Kubeflow.
  • Scientific publications in the NLP field.

How we develop JetBrains AI:

  • A cluster of hundreds of NVIDIA GPUs as training infrastructure.
  • Git for source control management.
  • Python, PyTorch, and HuggingFace as an ML stack.
  • Kubeflow and Weights & Biases for experiment tracking.
  • TeamCity as a CI Automation system.

We are an equal opportunity employer

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Exposure to regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government).

  • Führung deines Teams bei Kunden- & Partnerprojekten im Umfeld S/4HANA Transformation.

  • Du leitest und organisierst eigenverantwortlich Meetings, Workshops und Schulungen in internationalen Projekten.

  • Erarbeitung von technischen Konzepten und Erfassen von Kundenwünschen und -anforderungen.

  • Des Weiteren unterstützt du die Kollegen mit deinem Fundierten Kenntnissen im Pre-Sales.

Requirements

Dein Profil:

  • Technisches oder wirtschaftsorientiertes Studium (oder vgl. Ausbildung).

  • Einschlägige fachliche prozessuale Kenntnisse in mindestens einem SAP-Modul (z.B. FI, CO, MM, SD).

  • Erfahrung in der technischen und disziplinarischen Leitung und Organisation von IT-Projekten (klassisch und agil).

  • Technisches Verständnis verschiedener Migrationsansätze nach S/4HANA (Brownfield, Greenfield, SDT) wünschenswert.

  • Kenntnisse von Migrationswerkzeugen (SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, LSMW, Natuvion DCS oder vergleichbar) von Vorteil.

Ein Umfeld, dass jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. Daher bieten wir dir viele Benefits, wie europaweites flexibles Arbeiten, Mobilität und Altersvorsorge. Im Folgenden findest du mehr Informationen!

title: Copy of Director, Brand Marketing
